name: sports
description: Low sports car: very low bumper and bonnet edge, long flat bonnet, steep-raked windscreen. Tends to scoop the body up (wrap / roof vault at speed).
space: Vehicle space: metres, origin = ground point under the vehicle's centre; forward = driving direction. Angles in degrees: hood_angle = rise of the bonnet towards the windscreen, windshield_angle = from horizontal.
sources: Own generic class dimensions; bonnet-edge-height classes follow the pedestrian-impact literature (low / medium / high fronts).
